findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp-app" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: contact_form, submit_contact, agent_ready, email_agentready_report, ai_hub_search, newsletter, subscribe_newsletter · Private data: contact_form, submit_contact, ai_hub_search · Public sink: contact_form, submit_contact, email_agentready_report, newsletter, subscribe_newsletter · Destructive: email_agentready_report, agentready_scan.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: contact_form, submit_contact, agent_ready, email_agentready_report, ai_hub_search, newsletter, subscribe_newsletter · Private data: contact_form, submit_contact, ai_hub_search · Public sink: contact_form, submit_contact, email_agentready_report, newsletter, subscribe_newsletter · Destructive: email_agentready_report, agentready_scan

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
